item.title: Cleaning Up
item.content:encoded:
Hey folks, so after a decade or so after creating our beloved pizza box, I think I'm going to revise this article to sound a bit more in-keeping with the writing style of the site.

I was like, 19 when I wrote this and I feel that, beloved as it is, the article doesn't have quite as much of a clinical tone that other item logs do.

I don't want to change the spirit of the article, it'll still be a wholesome pizza box with a heart of gold, I just want it to feel like it wasn't written by a SCP fanboy.

item.title: Imagin
item.content:encoded: I'm probably not the first to say this and I probably won't be the last but, imagine having pizza everyday, but not just any pizza but, your favourite pizza. Sure you would get tired of pizza after a few days but, for the first few you would probably be feeling like a thousand dollars with all the pizza you would have. Someone should make (for a comedic purpose of course) a SCP that like pizza so much that it constantly breaks containment for a slice of that delicious pizza as one of its many traits, it would probably be classified as Euclid if it has other traits which it would, or else it would be a pointless thing to contain. I might write this in the future once I get enough inspiration. If someone dose or already has made something like this, please reply to let me know.
